asr_text: 11 labs agent skipping a tool call. Inside a sub agent, the model decides whether to call a tool. A dispatch tool node is different. When the flow reaches it, it runs. It has two special edges, a success path and a failure path. On failure, route to a transfer to number node and reach a human. Then use workflow analytics to find the step where calls go wrong. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 23.
